email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with a mild skin rash

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 30-year-old female patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their second dose of DemoZanix (dose: 25mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-05-20.
Approximately 7 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
A. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
